note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The registry, its references and every date are fictional, supplied placeholders; substituting one datum only shows a different configured value — nothing states a filing rule, fee, court, admissibility, deadline or any effect.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The filing stands in the registry intake tray with Ref. REG-0417 (fictional) stamped in its reference box and the entry on Day 2 (as supplied). The lens enlarges the reference box and the supplied reference is substituted by Ref. REG-0418 (fictional); a neutral Δ marker and a before/after note stay for the hold.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the inspected datum is the entry day. The lens enlarges the registry calendar's day cells and the entry glyph moves from Day 2 to Day 3 (both as supplied); the outcome tag follows. Different parties and documents.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths in every field: long party names and roles, case file, filing contents, date line, references, seven day labels, stage captions, prop labels, context caption and marker label. The two references keep their near-maximum length (50 characters) but are written with spaces ("REG 2024 000412 AB/01") rather than as one 21-character hyphenated token: an unbreakable token made the reference box a flat strip that no 16:9 lens window could enlarge to 35 % of the frame (measured: 0.31–0.33 of the short side).
